fullText: This is what crawls out of you when you take carvacrol and thymoquinone for two weeks straight. Day one, you swallow two soft gels, nothing dramatic. By evening, a faint gurgling. Something's waking up inside you. Day three, your stomach rumbles. The carbacrol from oregano oil is dissolving the biofilm shield parasites have been hiding behind for years. You visit the bathroom. What comes out surprises you? Stringy white things, dark clumps, stuff that has no business being inside a human body. Don't be alarmed. That's the parasites leaving. Day five, you reach for a cookie, your hand freezes mid air, the craving isn't there, your bloating starts deflating. The thymoquinone from black seed oil is flushing parasites out at every life stage now that the biofilm is gone. Adults, larvae, eggs. Day seven. In the mirror, the puffiness is gone. That belly that made you look six months pregnant by dinner, finally going down. You button your jeans, the fabric no longer strains. Day 10. You wake up at 7AM. You slept through the night. No tossing, no turning, no 3AM wake ups. Your brain fog lifts. Focus sharpens like a laser. Day 12. You touch your skin. The roughness is gone. Your energy doesn't crash at 3PM anymore. Parasites are no longer stealing your nutrients before your body can absorb them. Day 14. Your stomach is flat. Your digestion runs like clockwork. You walk past the candy aisle. Your eyes don't linger for a second. The sugar cravings are dead because the parasites demanding them are dead. Two soft gels. Fourteen days. That's all it took. Your exhaustion, your bloating, your brain fog, your cravings, your restless sleep. You thought these were separate problems. They weren't. They were all parasites.
